Seam chosen: **prompt TEXT mechanics vs prompt RESOLUTION**.

Binding survey first (both directions, per the config.py/Gerrit-1932 lesson):
- Patched ON the prompts module object: `_catalog_dir` (tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py:81 and by string at tests/unit/workflow/test_prompt_authoring.py:210), `_prompt_file` (tests/unit/test_prompt_variants.py:173,191), plus `get_prompt`/`resolve_prompt`/`resolve_prompt_cached` (patched on the module and consumed through it).
- Consequence: the catalog/index cluster (`_catalog_dir` -> `_index_path`/`_packaged_prompt_files` -> `get_prompt` -> `build_prompt_index` -> `build_index_document` -> `regenerate_prompt_index`) is WELDED by the `_catalog_dir` patch, and the variant-overlay cluster (`_prompt_file` -> `load_prompt` -> `check_prompt_parity`) is welded by the `_prompt_file` patch. Moving either would make those tests silently stop testing anything, or fail. Both stay in prompts.py.
- The one cluster free of any binding hazard is the prompt-TEXT primitives leaf: `_VAR`/`template_variables`/`_render_strict`, `_BASE_MARKER`, `VOLATILE_MARKER`/`split_volatile`/`strip_volatile_marker`, `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE`/`shared_plan_prefix`, `prompt_content_hash`. It is a CLOSED sub-graph: every edge is internal or into stdlib, no member calls anything else in prompts.py, and none is a monkeypatch target (zero string-literal hits repo-wide). Moving it as a LEAF means no circular import and no late-binding change.

`_main`/`regenerate_prompt_index` stay in prompts.py, so `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index` (CI drift gate, docs, test_generated_surface_markers) is untouched. prompts.py re-exports every moved name, matching the prompts_frontmatter precedent (epic 5ca8, docs/architecture.md:420).
